outcome.technical: scripts/diffmap.mjs: new AUDIT_DIR='docs/audit' constant; diffmap() now drops any path under docs/audit like the map's own output dir, so such files affect no area/node/entity and are never uncovered; readGitChanges() counts `behind` with rev-list pathspec ('.' ':(exclude)docs/audit'), so a commit touching only docs/audit is not a commit behind. That second part was needed because staleness.mjs (not in task scope, untouched) prints its line whenever behind>0, regardless of affected nodes. Header comment and JSDoc state the rule. skills/architecture-map/SKILL.md update flow now says diffmap ignores the map output dir and docs/audit/**. tests/diffmap.test.mjs: added d14 (end to end with a git repo, the CLI and the staleness hook: audit-only commit gives files [], no node, behind 0, hook prints nothing; a following commit with api/a.js, docs/guide.md and docs/audit changes gives nodes n-api and n-docs, behind 1, hook prints the 1 commit behind line). Gates: node --test tests/diffmap.test.mjs 14/14 pass; full node --test 457/457 pass. Dependants: scripts/staleness.mjs (import) still correct - it uses diffmap/readGitChanges and its own tests s1-s8 pass; behind is unchanged except for audit-only commits. tests/diffmap.test.mjs, merge/pipeline/evals/e2e basename mentions, model/html path mentions, skill/commands/pipeline tests: still correct, full suite green.
outcome.descriptive: Commits that touch only docs/audit no longer make the architecture map look stale: diffmap skips docs/audit/** and does not count such commits as behind.
